decision_reason: The best exact block candidate achieved only a 0.6809x median paired V5.1/V7 timing ratio and was about 1.47x slower than V5.1; it did not meet the required stable 10% speedup.

environment.machine_frequency_notes: Two repeatable timing regimes were observed during long runs: V5.1 was about 0.672-0.716 s early and 1.242-1.277 s under sustained load. Alternating paired ratios were therefore used for the decision; no reliable OS frequency counter was accessible.

benchmark_method.prediction_scope: predict_proba only; fit, preprocessing, disk I/O, CSV output, and plots excluded
benchmark_method.leaf_sweep_note: Every leaf candidate has one paired screening measurement and two raw candidate measurements; the selected finalist has nine pairs.

sorted.policy: stable sort on the highest-variance transformed training feature, then consecutive fixed-size chunks

recursive_range.policy: recursive median split on the feature with the largest numeric range in each node

recursive_variance.policy: recursive median split on the feature with the largest variance in each node

block_bound_implementation_candidates.reason: 0.815367 s bound phase versus 2.282603 s for the tensor in comparable measured runs

upper_bound_strategy.block_ordering: stable full argsort by lower bound, with stable block ID order for ties
upper_bound_strategy.argpartition_reason: optional and not justified after the stable sort phase was only about 0.152 s while the whole architecture was already slower
upper_bound_strategy.dynamic_upper_bound: evaluate the first ordered leaf(s) until k+1 rows, then use the exact k+1 distance
upper_bound_strategy.pruning_rule: keep LB <= U + tolerance; prune only LB > U + tolerance
upper_bound_strategy.tolerance_formula: 64 * float64_epsilon * max(1, abs(U), max(abs(all block LB)), query_squared_norm + max_training_squared_norm)
upper_bound_strategy.optimized_experimental_form: one exact seed leaf, conservative one-shot surviving-block set, then one exact refinement

exact_block_distance_candidates.reason: representative exact-distance phase was 0.100430 s versus 0.999546 s for direct feature-major

running_topk_candidates.reason: representative running-top-k phase was 0.057851 s for sort versus 0.202682 s for partition; the final nine-pair architecture retained the broad-sweep partition setting

guard_candidates.selection_reason: lowest measured guarded runtime; all guarded thresholds were close and all were slower than V5.1

hierarchy_candidates.reason: flat leaves were already clearly slower and their median pruning was only 1 of 94 blocks for the runtime finalist

memory.temporary_exact_candidate_payload_note: With the 25% guard, at most 6000 retained rows reach block refinement; index and float64 row vectors are each at most 48000 bytes before small top-k temporaries. NumPy allocator peak was not instrumented.
memory.extra_fit_time_payload_note: The sorted builder needs a 24000-entry int64 stable order (192000 bytes) plus the 33-value variance vector before persistent arrays are created.

final_v7.architecture: stable single-axis sorted 256-row leaves; feature-loop AABB bounds; stable full block argsort; exact first-block upper bound; conservative one-shot surviving-block refinement; gathered augmented distances; running stable sort; 25% performance guard; V5.1 full-population ambiguity fallback

production.full_experiment_reason: required only if V7 is accepted
